mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (srtn_cd, isin_cd, itms_nm, bas_dt, clpr, vs, flt_rt, mkp, hipr, lopr, trqu, tr_prc, lstg_st_cnt, mrkt_tot_amt, risk_level) VALUES (#{srtnCd}, #{isinCd}, #{itmsNm}, #{basDt}, #{clpr}, #{vs}, #{fltRt}, #{mkp}, #{hipr}, #{lopr}, #{trqu}, #{trPrc}, #{lstgStCnt}, #{mrktTotAmt}, #{riskLevel})
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM product p INNER JOIN (SELECT srtn_cd, MAX(bas_dt) AS max_bas_dt FROM product WHERE risk_level = #{riskLevel} GROUP BY srtn_cd) sub ON p.srtn_cd = sub.srtn_cd AND p.bas_dt = sub.max_bas_dt WHERE p.risk_level = #{riskLevel} ORDER BY CAST(p.flt_rt AS DECIMAL(10, 4)) DESC
